method: Same named docs-check-fixtures case in both arms; only the specified classifier repair is reverted in a root-owned isolated copy. The fixture assertions, exports and input selection are unchanged. No active-worktree source is reverted.

results.rule: A quoted operator request mentioning a document field remains attributed speech; a document-term-only record remains incidental. The reverted classifier suppresses the mixed request as document-term.
command: --test-name-pattern=^operator-word advisories classify incidental JSON, code and document terms apart from quoted replies$
results.expectedAssertion: actual document-term, expected attributed-speech, for the requested rename quote

caseSummary: ok 1 - operator-word advisories classify incidental JSON, code and document terms apart from quoted replies

results.postMutationFormatting: Prettier from the admitted checkout, using the file configuration; dist runtime controls retain emitted formatting.

caseSummary: not ok 1 - operator-word advisories classify incidental JSON, code and document terms apart from quoted replies
negative.assertion:
error: |-
    The operator requested: “Rename the field 'status' to 'state'.”
    + actual - expected
    
    + 'document-term'
    - 'attributed-speech'
    
  code: 'ERR_ASSERTION'
  name: 'AssertionError'
  expected: 'attributed-speech'
  actual: 'document-term'
  operator: 'strictEqual'

results.rule: A whole quoted operator request formatted as inline code remains attributed speech; assignments and embedded document tokens remain incidental code. The reverted mapper erases the requested quote before the classifier sees it.
command: --test-name-pattern=^operator-word advisories classify incidental JSON, code and document terms apart from quoted replies$
results.expectedAssertion: actual incidental-code, expected attributed-speech, for the requested inline-code quote

caseSummary: ok 1 - operator-word advisories classify incidental JSON, code and document terms apart from quoted replies

results.postMutationFormatting: Prettier from the admitted checkout, using the file configuration; dist runtime controls retain emitted formatting.

caseSummary: not ok 1 - operator-word advisories classify incidental JSON, code and document terms apart from quoted replies
negative.assertion:
error: |-
    The operator requested `"retain the original bytes"`.
    + actual - expected
    
    + 'incidental-code'
    - 'attributed-speech'
    
  code: 'ERR_ASSERTION'
  name: 'AssertionError'
  expected: 'attributed-speech'
  actual: 'incidental-code'
  operator: 'strictEqual'
